name: Jiangsu Nhwa Pharmaceutical Co., LTD
summary: Jiangsu Nhwa Pharmaceutical Co., LTD engages in research, development, production, and sale of central nervous system products in China. The company offers APIs, solid preparation, water injection, and freeze-dried powder formulations for depression, anxiety disorders, insomnia, severe mental disorders, and neurodegenerative diseases.
